title: tj.ladder/1: a season of takes (C-0005 section 4, game.ladder; lane A17)
$comment: The ladder lives in its own file (Game/Content/Cartridges/ladder/*.ladder.json), never in a play cut. The ladder object is C-0005's game.ladder; the envelope adds only the schema tag. Cross-file checks (each cartridge exists and validates, its id equals the preset id) are in ladder.mjs.

id.description: a kebab-case id such as season-one

cartridge.description: a preset id: the file ladder/<id>.cartridge.json
